**BEFORE TO OPEN A SECURITY REPORT, READ [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/DrewThomasson/ebook2audiobook/blob/main/SECURITY.md) AND MAKE SURE IT HASN'T ALREADY BEEN REPORTED. :)**

**IMPORTANT: DON'T COPY/PASTE ANY A.I. OR SCANNER REPORT WITHOUT A VERIFIED, REPRODUCIBLE IMPACT OR YOUR ISSUE WILL BE IMMEDIATELY CLOSED WITHOUT NOTICE**

**Issues are public: don't post a ready-to-use exploit, tokens, personal data or copyrighted eBooks.**

1)**Ebook2Audiobook Version**
- see VERSION.txt

2)**Operating System, Script Mode, Process Mode**
- Windows, Linux, MacOS
- Native, Docker
- Gradio, Headless

3)**Affected Component**
- file, CLI option, GUI element, workflow...

4)**Impact**
- what an attacker can do, and what access they need first (local network, GUI access, a crafted file...)

5)**Steps to Reproduce**
- use public-domain texts and your own test files only

6)**Suggested Fix (optional)**
